name: Turbo Templates Library for Elementor
author: Turbo Addons

sections.description:
Turbo Templates Library for Elementor provides a library of beautiful, professionally designed templates that you can import with just one click. Perfect for quickly building websites with Turbo Template and Elementor.

Features

  • 300+ professionally designed templates
  • Security hardening with input sanitization
  • Output escaping for XSS prevention
  • Translation ready with proper text domain
  • One-click import
  • Elementor compatibility
  • Mobile responsive designs
  • Regular template updates
  • Pro templates available
  • WP-CLI support
  • REST API integration

Template Categories

  • Landing Pages
  • Business
  • Portfolio
  • Blog
  • E-commerce
  • Agency

Requirements

  • Turbo Template (recommended)
  • Elementor (for Elementor templates)
  • WordPress 5.0+
  • PHP 7.4+

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services to provide template library functionality. No personal user data is transmitted to these services.

1. Template Library Service

  • Service: Turbo Templates API
  • Purpose: Retrieves available templates, template metadata, and demo content for the template library.
  • Data Sent: Template ID, template type (single or pack), pagination parameters, authentication tokens (non-personal system keys).
  • When Sent: When browsing templates, viewing previews, or importing templates.
  • Service URL: https://templates.wp-turbo.com/
  • Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: View Terms

2. Demo Content Hosting

  • Service: Turbo Addons Demo Content
  • Purpose: Hosts demo website content for preview and import functionality.
  • Data Sent: Requests for specific demo content files with non-personal User-Agent header.
  • When Sent: When users preview or import demo website content.
  • Service URL: https://demo.turbo-addons.com/
  • Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: View Terms

3. License Verification Service

  • Service: Turbo License API
  • Purpose: Verifies and manages premium license activation for pro templates.
  • Data Sent: License key, site URL, plugin version.
  • When Sent: When activating, validating, or checking license status.
  • Privacy Policy: View Terms
  • Terms of Service: View Terms

Note: All communications use WordPress HTTP API with appropriate timeouts. Users must have an active internet connection to access template library features.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/turbo-library-for-elementor/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Turbo Templates in your admin menu
  4. Browse and import templates
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor to use this plugin?

While many templates are designed for Elementor, the plugin also works with the WordPress block editor. Elementor templates require Elementor to be installed and active.

Are the templates free?

We offer both free and premium templates. Premium templates require a valid license key.

Can I customize the imported templates?

Yes! Once imported, you can fully customize the templates using Elementor or the WordPress editor.
